prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 7 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1218; do not mention it.)
text:
Treatment Summary

Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the patient was changing lanes. Patient reported immediate onset of neck pain with radiation into the upper trapezius region and low back pain with stiffness on waking. No loss of consciousness was reported. Initial examination showed limited cervical range of motion, paraspinal muscle tenderness in the cervical and lumbar regions, and no focal neurological deficits. Neurological screening and reflexes were within normal limits.

Over the course of seven visits, care consisted of manual therapy, soft tissue mobilization, graded therapeutic exercise for cervical and lumbar stabilization, and home exercise instruction. Patient also received guidance on activity modification and the use of heat and ice as needed. Pain levels and range of motion improved progressively across visits, with the most notable gains in lumbar mobility by the fourth visit.

At the most recent visit, patient reported residual intermittent neck stiffness and occasional low back discomfort with prolonged sitting, but functional capacity for work and daily activities had largely returned. Patient was discharged from active care with a home exercise program and was advised to return if symptoms worsen or fail to resolve.
